notes.title: Oh FLICK! Flick Shot Rogues is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41087771/6795115833e00f9a2dc02fb954ee76b50726bdaf.png[/img]

The wait is finally over: Flick Shot Rogues is out RIGHT NOW!

It’s been quite a journey getting here, and we want to thank all our family, friends, and playtesters who helped us get to this point.

We really hope you will enjoy our hero-flicking, turnbased roguelike!

And after playing, it would be pretty cool if you could take the time and leave a review on Steam!

Reviews will help us reach even more rogue-like likers and trick shot enthusiasts!

Also, say hi on our Discord server! We would love to hear from you, be it feedback, bug reports, or just a nice message!

Join here: https://discord.com/invite/3eXyP9gF2u

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427450/Flick_Shot_Rogues

notes.title: Squiggle Drop Is Part of the Wholesome Games Celebration!
notes.notes:
Experience the joy and creativity of Squiggle Drop, our delightful puzzle game featured in the Wholesome Games Celebration here on Steam!

In Squiggle Drop, your imagination is your greatest tool as you solve charming physics puzzles by drawing a single shape and watching what unfolds. With 250+ unique puzzles to tackle, each with multiple and often surprising solutions, Squiggle Drop promises endless fun and creativity!

As part of the Wholesome Games Celebration, Squiggle Drop is launching with a special 20% off discount. Don't miss this chance to add a touch of wholesome fun to your game collection!

Whether you're a seasoned puzzle solver or new to the genre, Squiggle Drop is sure to captivate your heart and mind.

Be sure to check out all of the other amazing games in the Wholesome Games Celebration as well!
